concept.title: Seat Belt
concept.shortdesc: The Operator Restraint System, Prevents the operator from jumping from the operator’s compartment in the

conbody.p: The Operator Restraint System, Prevents the operator from jumping from the operator’s compartment in the event of a forward or side tipover. The system is designed to keep the operator on the seat and in the operator’s compartment in the event of a tipover.
